Team — quick hygiene note as we lock Q4. Finance needs final upsell commit numbers for Acme Health by EOD tomorrow so we can include the revenue in the week-one forecast. Please use the checklist below and attach supporting docs where relevant.

Checklist (please reply inline):
- Confirm committed net ARR for Q4 (USD) and probability used (60/80/100%).
- List active blockers / top-two risks (contracting, procurement, integration).
- Confirm expected signature date and any DocuSign link.
- Attach the latest MAP (mutual action plan) and SOW if available.

I've attached a consolidated workbook (Q4_upside_rollup.xlsx) with the current rollup — please update the Acme line. If you cannot reach agreement on numbers, flag the reason and we'll treat it as downside.

Priority: high — AR team will start close planning on Oct 1.

Thanks,
